claims.claim: in a small Vermont lake spring food was 'mostly highly edible flagellates' while gelatinous greens dominated late summer (DeMott 1983; abstract only)
claims.note: No full text. The abstract says it in those words: in spring the grazers' food was 'composed mostly of highly edible flagellates', while 'resistant' algae (mostly gelatinous greens) were predominant during late summer AND autumn. The '(abstract only)' tag is accurate.

Consistent with the abstract (late summer and autumn). The abstract does not give the shares of edible and resistant algae; the full text's phytoplankton data (by season, and which taxa were classed 'resistant') would let the model's edible fraction be checked against a real seasonal series.
